name: cfg-router-auto-orchestrate
about: router.autoOrchestrate（parseRouterConfig.ts:525-645；RouterRuntime 编排模式）：判档为 complex（triggerTiers）时进入编排模式：allowedTools 只留 agent 与 read_file（同时给了 blockedTools，应以 allowedTools 为准并警告）、slimSystemPrompt=false、orchestrationPrompt 自定义、subagentMaxTokens=1000；mainAgentModel / subagentModel 已弃用只警告。判 simple 的一轮不进编排。比较请求里的工具与系统提示、事件、resolve_settings 的诊断。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        judge:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        cheap:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        big:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
router:
  enabled: true
  tokenSaver:
    judge: bbx/judge
    defaultTier: simple
    tiers:
      simple:
        model: bbx/cheap
      complex:
        model: bbx/big
  autoOrchestrate:
    triggerTiers: [complex]
    allowedTools: [agent, read_file]
    blockedTools: [bash]
    slimSystemPrompt: false
    orchestrationPrompt: BBX-ORCHESTRATION-PROMPT follow the plan.
    subagentMaxTokens: 1000
    mainAgentModel: bbx/big
    subagentModel: bbx/cheap
